summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc., a Vancouver-based foreign private issuer in pharmaceutical preparations, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its interim financial statements for the period ended July 31, 2026. The XBRL-tagged exhibit covers routine quarterly reporting items: license agreements with Yissum and BIRAD, share-based compensation via restricted share units, fair-value measurements of Taurus and Polyrizon warrants and shares, and a subsequent-event note referencing September 2026 investor financings involving shares, warrants and promissory notes. No special-situation transaction is disclosed. What to watch: the referenced September financing terms, potential dilution, and warrant overhang, not a deal catalyst.
